features.name: Oath Spells & Tenets
features.description:
**Oath of the Plaguetouched Spells**

| Paladin Level | Spells |
|---|---|
| 3rd | bane, protection from evil and good |
| 5th | enhance ability, lesser restoration |
| 9th | life from death, remove curse |
| 13th | blight, freedom of movement |
| 17th | greater restoration, hold monster |

**Tenets:** Bravery — Stand like a wall between terrible creatures and innocents. Stop the Spread of Undeath — Fight to ensure undead don't snuff out the light of life. Relentless — Remain vigilant always. Mercy — Care for the diseased; end suffering quickly when transformation is imminent.

features.name: Channel Divinity
features.description:
At 3rd level, you gain two Channel Divinity options:

**Protective Aura.** As a bonus action, summon a shining aura for 1 minute. Shed bright light 10 ft, dim light 10 ft further. Hostile creatures within 5 ft have disadvantage on their first attack each turn that isn't against you. Undead have disadvantage on all attacks not targeting you. Ends if you fall unconscious.

**Turn Undead.** As an action, present your holy symbol. Each undead within 30 ft that can see or hear you must make a WIS save or be turned for 1 minute or until it takes damage.

features.name: Aura of Radiant Energy
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, you and allies within 10 ft have resistance to necrotic damage. When you or a friendly creature hits an undead within 10 ft with a melee weapon attack, the attacker can choose to deal radiant or normal weapon damage. At 18th level, range increases to 30 ft.

features.name: Bulwark Against Death and Disease
features.description: Starting at 15th level, expend only 1 HP from your lay on hands pool to cure a disease. Your HP maximum can't be reduced. Advantage on saves against undead effects that reduce ability scores.

features.name: Scourge of Undeath
features.description:
At 20th level, as a bonus action, for 1 minute:

* The bright light from your Protective Aura is sunlight.
* Advantage on attack rolls against undead.
* An undead in your Aura of Radiant Energy takes extra radiant damage equal to twice your CHA modifier (min 2) when you or a friendly creature hit it with a melee weapon attack.

1/long rest.

payload.name: Scourge of Undeath
payload.description: For 1 min: Protective Aura sheds sunlight; advantage vs undead; undead in Aura take +2× CHA mod radiant on melee hits.
